# Self-Improvement Concepts Glossary

## Speculative Decoding (2026-10-20)
An acceleration method where a smaller draft model generates candidate tokens verified by the main model in parallel.

## Context Window (2026-10-15)
The total buffer size of input and output tokens an LLM can attend to during inference.

## Knowledge Graph (2026-11-01)
A structured representation of entities and their relationships stored as facts.
